semiconductor_relevance: High — Kenturn specializes in manufacturing precision spindles that are critical for semiconductor wafer processing.
summary: Kenturn Nano.Tec Co.,Ltd. designs and manufactures a range of machine tool spindles, including specialized spindles for semiconductor wafer processing. Their products enhance production efficiency and quality in processes such as wafer slicing, thinning, and polishing.
capabilities: Aerostatic spindles for wafer thinning and grinding
